action_guidance.none: No conversation or state change is justified now. Proposed labels remain independent.
action_guidance.comment: Use Reason to say what to ask or explain. Draft the exact public comment during the action pass.
action_guidance.close: Use Reason to name the checkable closure basis. Publish an explanation before closing.
action_guidance.reopen: Use Reason to explain what remains unresolved. Publish an explanation before reopening.
